title: 1 PDF -> Podcast, Slide Deck & Mind Map (Day 1/7)
description:
Day 1 of a 7-day AI workflow series: one PDF upload into NotebookLM's Studio panel now builds three finished outputs from the same sources -- a two-host Audio Overview podcast, a presentation-ready Slide Deck, and an interactive Mind Map -- with no separate podcast editor, slide app, or mind-mapping tool.

Sources: Google NotebookLM Help (Generate Audio Overview; Use Mind Maps; Generate a Slide Deck); Google Workspace Updates blog, March 2026 (Slide Deck customization); 9to5Google, Feb 2026 (mobile Slide Deck/Infographic customization).

Subscribe to AI Graphic TV for the rest of this 7-day series.

#ai #notebooklm #aiworkflow #productivity #aitools #studytips #shorts
